·˚✿ POLLINATIONS WEEKLY ✿˚·
    vol.46: tools & moving pixels

1. MCP tools now cover research papers, media inspection, voice processing, package registries, hashing, diffs, fractions, and version comparisons. The toolbox may need a toolbox.

2. Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash added paid video generation from text or up to two reference images, with synced audio and 3 to 15 second output. Wan 3.0 supports 2 to 15 second clips. GPT Image 2.6 Flare added animated GIFs.

3. Three paid-only ElevenLabs models added sound effects, batch transcription with word timestamps and speaker labels, and realtime transcription. Claude Fable 5.2 was added.

4. Enter added Agents and MCP pages and brought a user's Agents, Models, and Apps into My listings. 28 community apps joined the catalog.

5. Legacy image limiter failures return 503 with Retry-After: 10; cached images remain available. Responses API and SDK fixes clarify failed or partial output. Catalog and leaderboard caching cuts repeat work; leaderboard totals may lag.

Code and contributions: https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations

#OpenSource #AI #DevTools #BuildInPublic
